<strong>GitHub release</strong> is the s: GitHub release is the standard option and works without git. Git checkout follows a branch and is meant for development: an installed checkout is updated in place.
Configure duration and clock behavior. T: Configure duration and clock behavior. These values control execution cadence and stop conditions.
Deletes the local files of the plugin af: Deletes the local files of the plugin after a confirmation. For Microblogging and Forum it removes both server and client; to remove only one, use the plugin page.
Each card opens the dedicated creation i: Each card opens the dedicated creation interface for that resource type.
Each row shows the plugin, its descripti: Each row shows the plugin, its description and its status: Installed, Not installed or Partially installed (only one of server and client). Plugins that can be switched on and off also show Enabled or Disabled.
For each repository: whether it is insta: For each repository: whether it is installed, the version (release archive, or git branch and commit), the latest published release and the dependency and validation checks.
Install, update or remove this plugin an: Install, update or remove this plugin and follow what happens. The badges at the top say whether it is installed, enabled, or needs a restart.
Microblogging and Forum have a server an: Microblogging and Forum have a server and a client. Each has its own block below: install, update or remove one without touching the other.
Most pages apply changes through forms. Review required fields before submitting to avoid partial updates.
Only compatible populations for the sele: Only compatible populations for the selected ad hoc type are shown to prevent invalid client configuration.
Opens the page of the plugin, where you: Opens the page of the plugin, where you choose the source (GitHub release or git branch), install or update it and read the output of the operation.
Optionally connect a token for this sess: Optionally connect a token for this session to avoid GitHub rate limits or to reach private releases.
Pick the plugin family first. This drive: Pick the plugin family first. This drives which populations and optional settings become available.
Plugin-defined controls appear here when: Plugin-defined controls appear here when required by the selected ad hoc agent type.
Resources are organized by group to sepa: Resources are organized by group to separate standard flows and plugin-provided capabilities.
Runs the operation, then installs the de: Runs the operation, then installs the dependencies, validates the plugin and migrates its schema. Dependencies and Validate can be run again on their own; Remove deletes the local files. Operations are blocked while experiments that use the plugin are running.
The list of plugins available to this in: The list of plugins available to this installation, with what each one does and whether it is installed. Microblogging and Forum each stand for a server and a client.
The terminal output of the latest operat: The terminal output of the latest operations, newest first. When something fails, the reason is here. The page reloads when an operation finishes.
The top toolbar hosts quick actions such: The top toolbar hosts quick actions such as replay tutorial, account shortcuts, and active simulation access.

Use the sidebar to move between experime: Use the sidebar to move between experiment setup, users, agents, and system tooling.
